title: Nice old school style clock, alarm and radio
text: Nice old school style clock, alarm and radio. If you are in the market for an alarm clock, this Pingko is the way to go. I love the fact that I can have the display dim during the overnight hours so that it will not disrupt my sleep. This clock is visible from anywhere in the room and certainly makes seeing the time an easy thing to do. In this day and age where everyone is using their smart phones to alarm and tell time, this is so much easier (and old school) so you don't need to pick up anything to see the time. This would be great for traveling and I will take it on my upcoming cruise in August.

product_metadata.title: PINGKO Digital Alarm Clock with FM Radio-Large Smart LED Display, Snooze Function,Adjustable Brightness -Small and Light for Travel,Desk or Bedroom (Black)
features: 🎼【LARGE DISPLAY】Easy to read due to a large LED display.This premium digital clock is something you’ll enjoy waking up to every morning.
🎼【ADJUSTABLE BRIGHTNESS】With four levels of brightness control, simply dim the brightness for night and turn it up during the day.Wouldn't interrupt your sleep.
🎼【DIGITAL FM RADIO】Easy tuning in FM radio channel in 76.0-108.0 MHz. A 23-inch antenna is attached for better signal reception.Speaker is loud and clear.
🎼【CONVENIENT】Charge your small digital clock with any micro USB cable, the same charger for most Android phones.Included a charging cable our smart clock for your convenience
